   Authors: Wenxia Huang, Rongchen Zhao
   Journal: Endocrine
   Publication Date: 2025-02-10

   Abstract: To explore outcomes of metformin (Met) as an antihyperglycemic agent in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) combined with chronic heart failure (CHF).

2. **Effect of metformin on all-cause and cardiovascular mortality in patients with coronary artery diseases: a systematic review and an updated meta-analysis.**
   Authors: Yechen Han, Hongzhi Xie, Yongtai Liu, Peng Gao, Xufei Yang, Zhujun Shen
   Journal: Cardiovascular diabetology
   Publication Date: 2020-05-04
   PMID: 31362743
   PMC ID: 6668189 (Full text available)
   Abstract: Metformin is the most widely prescribed drug to lower glucose and has a definitive effect on the cardiovascular system.
